accuracyFlags: Argues booking-funded apps are biased toward paid sites and that a subscription removes the incentive, without disclosing that AussieCamps itself earns from BookEasy partner bookings and sells a Pass; honest-status disclosure missing.
No statement of the free vs Pass boundary (free = BookEasy stays and tours only; campgrounds, parks, rest areas, dump points, guides, trips need the Pass).
Footer: 'Find 74,000+ Australian places offline' conflicts with the page's own advice to distinguish cached tiles from details; the app has no offline maps.
'Offline data is the first test' implies the recommended product's offline coverage; ensure the AussieCamps claim is place details and guides only.
